title: BABY COUSIN TAY TAY & DJ Roselle
bio:
ETHER.NET Radio w/BABY COUSIN TAY TAY & DJ Roselle

*Monthly*

Travel the world and transcend time through sound with the creators of North Carolina’s DRIPSWEAT.club as they curate a monthly mix of old, new and unreleased music. You can expect a range of genres, influences and inspirations, as well as occasional guest mixes from precious friends.
